story.titleZh: 遇见Yasmeen：2025年aramco STEM挑战赛三名获胜者之一
story.summaryZh: Yasmeen是2025年aramco STEM挑战赛的三名获胜者之一。她在AMR技术中心的沉浸周活动中，通过亲身体验碳纤维制造和解决赛车燃油策略挑战，更接近了F1赛车背后的工程。
story.originalTitle: Meet Yasmeen, one of three winners of the 2025 @aramco STEM Challenge. From seeing carbon fibre manufacturing first-hand to tackling a race fuel strat...
story.summaryEn:
Meet Yasmeen, one of three winners of the 2025 @aramco STEM Challenge.
From seeing carbon fibre manufacturing first-hand to tackling a race fuel strategy challenge, Yasmeen’s Immersion Week at the AMR Technology Campus brought her closer to the engineering behind an F1 car.
detailZh:
遇见Yasmeen，她是2025年aramco STEM挑战赛的三位获胜者之一。
从亲眼目睹碳纤维制造到应对赛车燃油策略挑战，Yasmeen在AMR技术校园的沉浸周让她更接近F1赛车背后的工程。
